item.title: BSA installs new CT scanner to expand diagnostic capabilities
item.description: The BSA Health System has installed a new Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography (PET/CT) scanner to expand the hospital's diagnostic imaging capabilities.

item.title: Comanche Trail Golf Complex to close Thursday for upgrade
item.description: The City of Amarillo said the Comanche Trail Golf Complex will be closed to the public on Thursday for a scheduled upgrade.

item.title: NMSP searching for suspects near Fort Sumner area who were alleged to have shot at officers
item.description: New Mexico State Police reported that it is searching for a man and woman who were alleged to have shot at a NMSP officer during a traffic stop Monday near US 285.

item.title: Bird flu circulating in wild birds in Amarillo, Lubbock
item.description: The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department reported that highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) was found to be circulating among wild birds in Amarillo and Lubbock.

item.title: Former Texan in Puerto Vallarta: 'Black smoke just covering the whole city' from cartel violence
item.description: Paul Kirkpatrick lives in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico, which erupted into cartel retaliation violence on Sunday after the Mexican army killed cartel leader El Mencho.

item.title: WTAMU President Wendler provides update on PPHM
item.description: West Texas A&M University President Dr. Walter Wendler is providing an update on the progress of maintaining the Panhandle-Plains Historical Museum's presence on the university campus on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
